raw_definitions: Definisi : 2. showing or expressing thanks, /menampakkan, memperlihatkan/ tanda /kesyukuran, terima kasih/: she had a ~ look on her face, wajahnya menampakkan tanda kesyukurannya. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
